title: traffic sign v1, one country
description: One country's version of a sign in skifahrer/traffic-signs: `signs/<category>/<sign>/<country>/<sign>-<country>.json`. Its national code, its image and where both came from. The sign's names are in the names file next to the country folders (sign-names.schema.json).

$schema.description: The schema the file follows: this schema's $id.

sign.description: The sign's folder, the same as in the path.

category.description: The category's folder, the same as in the path.

country.description: The country's folder, the same as in the path.

code.description: The sign's number in the country's own catalogue, as written there: `101`, `A 1a`, `W1-1`, `Zeichen 101` without the word.

image.description: The current image. Absent until it is downloaded, and after the sign left its source page (then `valid_until` is set and the image is in `archived`).

valid_until.description: The sign left its source page: the last year it was known to be in use. Absent while it is current.

archived.description: Earlier images, oldest first. Absent when there are none.

slug.description: English, lowercase, words joined by single hyphens: `bend-left`, `speed-limit-50`, `maximum-weight-3-5t`.

category.description: Closed: a value outside the list makes the file unreadable.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase (`sk`, `us`), or ISO 3166-2 for a region of a country (`us-ca`).

sha1.description: Lowercase hex, as Wikimedia Commons reports it.

imageFile.description: A file in the country's folder: `<sign>-<country>.<ext>`, or `<sign>-<country>-archived-<year>[-<n>].<ext>` for an archived one.

sha1.description: Of the file's bytes, so a sync downloads it again only when Commons has a new version.

source.description: The file's description page on Wikimedia Commons.

author.description: As Commons names it; null when it names none.

license.description: Short name: `Public domain`, `CC BY-SA 4.0`, `OGL v1.0`; null when Commons names none.

license_url.description: The licence's text; null when it has no page.

file.description: The renamed file; null when there was none on disk to keep.

valid_until.description: The last year the image was known to be valid: when the sync noticed it had gone.

page.description: The page that lists the sign.

file.description: The image's name on that page, as the page writes it.
